spans.s: उशनस् m. (nom. sing. voc. sing. उशनस्, उशन, उशनः) Śukra, son of Bhṛgu and preceptor of the Asuras. He is known as a writer on civil and religious law (Yaj.i.4), as an authority on civil polity (अध्यापितस्योशनसाऽपि नीतिम् K.S.iii.6, शास्त्रमुशनसा प्रणीतम् Panch.v.), and as noted for his wisdom (कवीनामुशना कविः Bg.x.37.)
उष m. 1. Early morning; 2. a libidinous man; 3. saline earth.
उषा (I) f. 1. Early morning; 2. morning light; 3. twilight; 4. saline earth; 5. name of a daughter of the demon Bāṇa. (See App. II.); 6. a cooking pan or pot. Cf. उखा.
उषा (II) ind. Early in the morning.
ऊष m. 1. An acid; 2. the cavity of the ear; 3. dawn, day-break; 4. the Malaya mountain; 5. saline earth.
उषण n. 1. Black pepper; 2. ginger.
ऊषण n. Black pepper. (Also ऊषणा.)
उषप m. 1. Fire; 2. the sun.
उषस् f. 1. Morning light; 2. dawn, morning, प्रदीपार्चिरवोषसि R.xii.1, व्रीडावनम्रवदनामुषसि स्मरामि Ch.
; 3. the deity that presides over the morning and evening twilight (often used in the dual).
उषर्बुध m. fire.
उषसी f. The evening twilight.
उषा-कल m. a cock.
उषा-तन m. morning early.
उषा-पति, -रमण m. a name of Aniruddha, husband of उषा.
उषा-पति, -रमण m. a name of Aniruddha, husband of उषा.
ऊषक n. Day-break.
ऊषर (I) a. (f. रा) Impregnated with salt.
ऊषर (II) m.n. A barren spot with saline soil.
ऊषर (I) a. (f. रा) Impregnated with salt.
ऊषवत् a. See ऊषर a.
